status.en: 27 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 23% more than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Aleppo and Quneitra.
status.nb: 27 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 23 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Damascus, Aleppo og Quneitra.

summary.en: Armed incidents rose to 27 in the past week, a 23% increase, concentrated in Damascus, Aleppo and Quneitra, with two of them reported by multiple sources. Battle‑related deaths total 2,732 for 2024. Security forces have arrested a former Republican Guard brigadier general and two suspects linked to planned attacks on religious sites. Drone and air strikes near the Syrian‑Lebanese border have wounded six people and caused injuries in Lebanon. Pro‑Damascus rallies in Hasaka have sparked clashes, adding to the unrest.
summary.nb: Væpnede hendelser økte til 27 i den siste uken, en 23 % økning, konsentrert i Damaskus, Aleppo og Quneitra, med to av dem rapportert av flere kilder. Kamprelaterte dødsfall utgjør 2 732 for 2024. Sikkerhetsstyrker har arrestert en tidligere brigadegeneral fra Republikken Guard og to mistenkte knyttet til planlagte angrep på religiøse steder. Drone‑ og luftangrep nær den syrisk‑libanesiske grensen har såret seks personer og forårsaket skader i Libanon. Pro‑Damaskus‑demonstrasjoner i Hasaka har utløst sammenstøt, noe som øker uroen.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
